objective: Determine how many original BAS Version2 chinstrap GPS deployments can be reliably time-aligned with actual pressure-defined dives, then compare original-dive-linked movement locations with previously published Freer krill GAM surfaces across matched South Orkney islands, without climate causality claims.

modelled_krill.source: Freer 2025 hurdle GAM trained on IMR 2011–2020 acoustics and sea ice/salinity

primary_source_gates: ID exact same original deployment in GPS v2 and TDR v2. Do not use known-mismatched v1.
Original pressure field units, valid timestamp field, timestamp precision and time zone must be checked; unknown clock-offset direction means NO JOIN.
Zero-offset calibration and raw pressure QC explicitly separated from ecological thresholds; pressure > threshold is potential dive, not feeding.
No interpolated positioning over original GPS temporal gaps longer than 10 minutes; time of linked GPS fix must differ from dive timestamp <=5 minutes, with valid bracketing constraints.
Use single tag/deployment as the observational unit. Do not count ~1-second pressure samples or GPS fixes as independent island/year environmental replicates.
Retain every island-year and every original file missingness. No modification of source raw GPS/TDR values to rescue a desired krill direction.

dive_candidate_protocol.offset_proposal: per-deployment time-varying 1st percentile pressure in fixed 60-minute windows with ≥300 valid measurements, linearly interpolated; if insufficient surface support, do not assign calibrated depth
dive_candidate_protocol.event_location_time: time of corrected-pressure maximum within event
dive_candidate_protocol.note: Exact offset/clock QC must be implemented and source-audited before inference; thresholds fixed here before source pressure values inspected

gps_link_protocol.primary_island_anchor: median first original GPS fix per island and breeding season, source-only
gps_link_protocol.location_representation: use actual nearest recorded GPS fix, never label it exact dive location; no between-fix interpolation in primary
gps_link_protocol.coordinate_uncertainty: report temporal offset, bracket length, sensor GPS gaps and proportion of events unlocalized

ecological_comparison.main: same species chinstrap, within observed same breeding season, compare dive-associated vs all GPS fixed modelled krill surface values at equal-tag then equal-island-year grain
ecological_comparison.support: do not compute species or island food-effect slope when <3 qualified dive-tag deployments per group
seasonal_raster_alignment: Jan-Feb T before colony breeding season
ecological_comparison.primary_weighting: each deployment's distinct visited model cells equal-weighted; deployment means equal-weighted within island-year
ecological_comparison.biological_outcome: no reproductive mechanism until same-island original nest/fledgling data can be matched externally

absolute_exclusions: No new acoustic observational data from the published krill raster (already model fitted)
No assumption that every pressure dive was krill capture
No independent sea-ice/salinity test on a GAM trained with those predictors
No p values treating fix/dive/tag as independent climate replicates
No future 2050/2100 nest number, occupied patch, N_eff or vegetation projections
